title: Church of San Francisco Acatepec
geometryBasis: Named church enclosure and local street shape anchor the footprint. The approximate footprint and massing were determined from the public-domain orbiting drone footage rectified to map points.
sectionBasis: The cleared original clips and stills document the unequal towers, tiled facade, red vaulted roofs, white nave exterior, glazed dome and courtyard gallery.
limitations: Ground dimensions are estimates from the mapped enclosure and airborne views, with some hidden wall feet inferred.
The fine Talavera arrangement and sculpture are generalized. The freestanding gate, cemetery, wall perimeter and interior are outside the modeled building scope.
Copernicus surface samples can include urban roofs and cannot resolve door-step heights.
